info.title: Sales Force API
info.description: Sales Force HTTP API. Generated from the Zod contracts in @salesforce/contracts; do not edit by hand. Decimal values are strings. Errors use { code, message, details? }.

get.description: The process is up. Does not check the database or the integration.
Database, migration level and integration summary. A degraded integration does not make the API not ready.

post.description: Sets the HttpOnly session cookie. The response body carries no token.
